def search_email(email):
    matches=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        res = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        print('search page', page_index, 'for', email, 'returned', len(res) if isinstance(res, list) else res)

        matches.extend(res)
        page_index += 1

# Normalize parent contacts

# Helper to search all Venmo users matching an email (paginate)

    matches=[]
    page_index=0

        res = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)

for p in parents:
